reviews.name: SuzeS
reviews.title: New kitchen.. absolutely perfect
reviews.review: Chris and his team installed a kitchen for me, brilliant job. Turned up when they said they would, very polite and respectful. Very helpful and understanding when I changed things. Great lads, would highly recommend them. They even cleaned up after themselves. Perfect and I love my new kitchen.

reviews.name: LizF
reviews.title: Garden Makeover.
reviews.review: I can’t recommend Chris and his team highly enough for the fantastic job they did transforming my garden. They were always punctual, and their attention to detail and care throughout the project was exceptional. I’m absolutely delighted with the results—from the rendering and painting to the brickwork and the beautiful raised bed. Thank you!

reviews.name: DeniseF
reviews.title: Fantastic kitchen fitting experience.
reviews.review:
Chris and all the guys recently fitted my new kitchen. Well to say I’m delighted with it all is an understatement. 
They were reliable, professional, friendly the quality of the work is exceptional. After each day they cleaned up any mess, I cannot praise Purnells Property Maintenance enough.
When we are ready for our new bathroom fitted Chris and the guys will be my first and only port of call.
We have had a couple of totally rubbish tradesmen in the past but Purnells Property Maintenance, I will recommend to anyone and everyone ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ for everything from reliability, quality of work and the time of completion. A fantastic team!!
Thank you so much to Chris and the guys for my dream kitchen. I will see you all again for our new bathroom 😊😊😊

reviews.name: RejiA
reviews.title: Fully recommended.
reviews.review: The work from Chris and the team was excellent, the current work completed and as a customer I am fully satisfied with the results, decided to give another bigger job at the house to complete my kitchen. You could ask the team for any of your doubts or concerns, they are always happy to answer.

reviews.name: MacieC
reviews.review: Would highly recommend Purnells Property Maintenance. Very friendly, polite, and professional service. Would definitely use them again! Level of service was excellent and the quality of work completed was to a high standard. Very efficient in completing the work.

reviews.name: DavidR
reviews.title: Large patio, steps & fencing project completed promptly, and to a very high standard.
reviews.review:
Absolutely highly recommend Chris Purnell for any building or renovation work.
They have just completed a fabulous job transforming our garden. Great help and guidance all the way.
New sandstone patio plus full width of garden steps…. and to finish it off slatted fencing and glass balustrade. Just amazing we are over the moon.
Enjoyed a bbq last night admiring it all.
Thumbs up from us, don’t think twice for any of your home improvement needs. A clean, polite and reliable team.
